content: Saꞌila weyahina
Ma Yesu tupwaina ꞌiꞌebesineya ma Yudiya ꞌina tupwa ꞌitauya, ma ꞌihabala weꞌaha Yolidani hali tupwa, eeta boda madouna siꞌetoꞌauta hilama ꞌoina, ma mumuganaina gide wete ꞌiheꞌita ꞌoidiya.
Ta Palisiyao sinaoma ma nuwanuwadi Yesuina sitoho, ꞌoinega sihesilala ꞌoina, sigwae, “Bada, togidega ꞌida loina saꞌila weyahina? Sawasawahina loheya mwanena ꞌisaꞌile?”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Togidega Mosese loina ꞌiꞌebwaya ꞌesegomiya?”
Ma Palisiyao sigwaeya, “Mosese ꞌitagwala ma ꞌeguma loheya nuwanuwana ma ꞌisaꞌila, nugeta pepa ꞌaigeda ꞌoina ꞌina guipaila ꞌihepwaile, ma mwanena ꞌiꞌebwae, ma ꞌisaꞌile.”
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Mosese loina beno ꞌiꞌebwaegomiya ꞌimi deba paꞌala weyahina.
Ma hesi wanuwatuhuyahi Yehoba ꞌina hemasalaha hauhauna ꞌoinega tomota ꞌeluwa ꞌihemasalahediya, loheyana ma mewahinena.
Bewa lamuna ꞌoinega loheya tamana ta sinana ꞌiꞌebesinedi, ma mwanena baꞌidana simiyaluwa,
ma siteluwaedi wahidi ꞌaigeda tuwa. Mwalo siteluwaedi simiya wasiwasiya, ma bewa tutaina ꞌoina siloꞌaigeda.
Yehoba ꞌilagu ꞌaigedediya, ꞌoinega geya sowana tomota sitoho ma silagulagu wasiyedi.”
Muliyetega Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao sihila hadai, ma tomuliyaowedi sihesilala hila saꞌila weyahina.
Eeta Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, “Ceguma taiya loheya mwanena ꞌisaꞌile ma ꞌihaibala, loheya bewa mwanena nugenugetaina ꞌoina galana ꞌipaihoweya, weyahina ꞌiganawala.
Ma wete ꞌeguma wahine mwanena ꞌisaꞌile ma ꞌihaibala, wahineina ꞌiganawala.”
Yesu gwagwama ꞌigwae helauwediya
Ma tomota gwagwama siꞌewedima Yesu ꞌoina ꞌabehega ꞌiꞌabi tohodi. Ma hesi ꞌana tomuliyao gwagwamaedi siꞌausidiya.
Ma Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌiꞌitediya ma ꞌiheliyediya, ꞌigwae, “Sahena gwagwama waꞌauꞌausidi, ma hesi watagwaledi ma ꞌoiguwa sinaoma, weyahina gwagwama bewa gide Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌilobwainediya.
Yahegwaegomi ꞌeguma taiyewedi taudi geyaꞌabwa gwagwama bewa gide ꞌidi hemisa, nata sahena Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina siluhuluhu.”
Coinega Yesu gwagwamaedi ꞌiꞌahalidiya, ma wete ꞌiꞌabi tohodiya, eema ꞌigwae helauwediya.
Wasawasa weyahina

Ma Yesu ꞌitoholo ꞌitautauya, ma ꞌaigeda loheya ꞌipilima, ma ꞌiꞌetuluha Yesu matana, ma ꞌigwaeya, “Bada, yasanapugowa ꞌabehega ꞌowa toheꞌita bwebweꞌau, ꞌoinega toꞌaha yada paihowa ma ꞌane yawasigu miyamiya hatayana yaloba?”
Ma Yesu loheyaina ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Togidega ma ꞌoinega ꞌuꞌahwa bwebweꞌanegauwa? Geya ꞌeta taiya wete bwebweꞌana, beno tuwa Yehoba.
Ma Yehobaina ꞌina loinao ꞌusanapu pwaidiya, beno ꞌabehega:

content.text: Sahena ꞌabowega tomota ꞌidi tobwatobwa ꞌuꞌewaꞌewadi.
Ma wete tamau ma sinau ꞌuheꞌasisiyanedi.”

content: Ma loheyaina ꞌigwaeya, “Bada, ꞌigu tuta sedasedega ꞌana siga nige, loinaedi yamuliya bwaibwainidiya.”

Coinega Yesu maꞌina yaliyaya loheyaina ꞌiꞌebubuya ma ꞌigwae, “Beno tuwa ꞌaigeda ginaula ꞌilosapuligowa. Coinega ꞌuhila ꞌino ꞌasa, ma ꞌino tobwatobwa mabwaiyana ꞌuhegimwaneye, ma ꞌadi maisa ꞌuheguyaiye towewelohe ꞌoidiya, eema ꞌunaoma ꞌumuliyegau, ꞌabwa muliyetega ꞌino wasawasa galewa ꞌuloba hila.”
Gwae bewa loheyaina ꞌihesagoheya, ma ꞌina wasawasa madouna weyahina nuwana ꞌigala moisa, ma maꞌina nuwagala ꞌihila, ta Yesu ꞌina gwaeina geya ꞌimuliye.
Coinega Yesu ꞌiloꞌita dadana ma ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Ceguma taiyawedi taudi maꞌidi wasawasa madouna, ꞌidi luhu Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌalona mwauna.”
Ma ꞌana tomuliyao nuwadi ꞌihepwanopwanowa ꞌina gwaeina weyahina. Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Natugwao, Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌana luhu mwau hedada.
Ee moisa, kameli tauna hebahebai madouna, ꞌoinega tupwana mwauna ma nidili ꞌana bwalena ꞌoinega kameliina ꞌiluhu, ma hesi towasawasao ꞌidi luhu Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina mwau hedada.”
Yesu ꞌina gwaeina ꞌana tomuliyao sihesagoheya ma nuwadi ꞌihepwanopwano hedada, ma sihegwaeya, “Ceguma beno gide, taiya hede sawasawahina ma ꞌebe yaliyayaina ꞌiloba?”
Coinega Yesu ꞌiꞌeꞌebubudi ma ꞌigwaeya, “Ginaula bewa mwau hedada tomota ꞌoidiya, ma hesi geya mwauna Yehoba ꞌoina, weyahina Yehoba ꞌoina ginaula mabwaiyana sowasowana.”
Ta Pita Yesu ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Bada, tauma togidega? Weyahina ꞌima tobwatobwao mabwaiyadi ꞌaꞌebesinediya ma ꞌamuliyegowa.”

Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Ee moisa, ꞌeguma taiyawedi ꞌomi ꞌimi hadao ta tasimiyao ta nuhumiyao ta sinamiyao ta tamamiyao ta natumiyao ta ꞌimi baleꞌu wete waꞌebesinediya, ma wete muya waloba weyahigu ta wasa bwebweꞌana ꞌana hepwaila weyahina, ꞌami maisa tuta bewa waloba gide handeledi hadao ta tasimiyao ta nuhumiyao ta sinamiyao ta natumiyao ta ꞌimi baleꞌu wete, ma ꞌabwa galewa yawasimi hataya wete waloba.
Ta bewa tutaina tohanugetao baibaiwadi ꞌabwa simuliya, ma taudi simulimuliya ꞌabwa sinugeta.”
Yesu ꞌina ꞌamasa ꞌana hepwaila hetoina

Cabwa ꞌedai sihanehane Yelusalema weyahina, ma Yesu ꞌinugenugeta ma ꞌana tomuliyao simulimuliya, ta maꞌidi nuwapwanopwano, ma tupwadi tomota wete maꞌidi ꞌateyoho ꞌedai simulimuliyedi. Eeta ꞌana tomuliyao site tuwelowedi ꞌibwau ꞌautehiledima ma ꞌihemataluwediya toꞌaha ꞌiꞌiunamo ma ꞌilatu ꞌoina,

ꞌigwaeya, “Bewa tuta tahane Yelusalema, ma nobwa ꞌagu totebaina taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌitebaegau topwaoli madoudi ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌigu ꞌamasa weyahina siloina, ma muliyetega siheꞌebwaegau taudi geya meYudiya ꞌoidiya,
ma taudi meganamuli silotuyanegau ta siꞌesohegau ta gulahega sisapigau ma ꞌoinega siloheꞌamasigau, ma sabwelo ꞌetoi yatoholohila.”
Yemesa ma Yoni ꞌidi ꞌahwanoi Yesu ꞌoina
Coinega Yemesa ma Yoni, taudi Sebedi natunao, Yesu ꞌoina sinaowa, sihegwaeya, sigwae, “Bada, ꞌanaoma sabi ꞌahwanoi ꞌoiuwa.”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Toꞌaha nuwanuwami ma yapaihowa weyahimi?”
Coinega sigwaeya, “Cabwa ꞌino ꞌebeloina ꞌoina nuwanuwama ma deiuwa ꞌamiyatoi, ꞌaigeda ꞌino ꞌebeulega ma ꞌaigeda ꞌino ꞌadigeyegeyega.”

Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Comi ꞌimi ꞌahwanoiina lamuna geya wasanapu. Togidega? Muya ꞌana biyoina yanuma, sawasawahina ma ꞌomi wete ꞌoinega wanuma? Ma wete babitaiso mwauna ꞌabwa yaloba, togidega ꞌomi wete gide sawasawahimi ma wababitaiso ꞌesa?”
Ta sigwaeya, “Sawasawahima.” Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Moisa, biyoina ꞌabwa ꞌoinega yanuma, ꞌomi wete ꞌoinega wanuma, wete babaitaisoina ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌiunamo ꞌabwa yababitaiso ꞌomi wete ꞌoinega wababitaiso,
ma hesi geya sawasawahigu ma yahesinuwa taiyewedi ꞌabwa ꞌigu hetoloina ꞌoina ꞌigu ꞌebeulega ma ꞌigu ꞌadigeyegeyega simiyatoi, weyahina Yehoba tauna ꞌina ꞌebeloina ma ꞌihesinuwa.”
Ta tomuliyao site teni Yemesa ma Yoni ꞌidi ꞌahwanoi sihesagoheya ma sigamwasowalediya.
Eeta Yesu mabwaiyadi ꞌibwau heꞌautediya ma ꞌihegwaediya, “Comi wasanapuya taudi baleꞌuwa sibwauwediya ꞌabehega babadao, ꞌidi tomotaiyao siloiloina paꞌaledi.
Ma ꞌomi geyaꞌabwa wete gide taudi wapaipaihowa ꞌesa. Ma hesi taiya ꞌowa ꞌeguma nuwanuwau ma ꞌoimiyega ꞌuhetoloina, ꞌilobwainegowa ma ꞌiyamwao weyahidi ꞌuhetopaihowa.
Ta wete ꞌeguma taiya ꞌowa nuwanuwau ma ꞌoimiyega ꞌuhetohanugeta, ꞌilobwainegowa ma ꞌiyamwao mabwaiyadi weyahidi ꞌuhetopaihowa.

“Taugu Loheyaiguina wete gide ꞌigu suluma baleꞌuwa geya ꞌabehega tomota weyahigu sipaihowa, ma hesi sabi paihowa tomota weyahidi, ma wete yatagwalegauwa ma yaꞌamasa tomota mabwaiyami ꞌami ꞌebelihasa weyahina.”
Batimiyo matana ꞌibwebweꞌana

Eeta sitautauya Yeliko, ma tutaina Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao Yeliko siꞌebesineya boda madouna siꞌwayabudiya, ta tomata gibugibu sanina Batimiyo silobeya, tauna Timiyo natuna, ma tuta baibaiwana ꞌeda papalina ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya, ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi mane ta tobwatobwa weyahidi.
Ma Batimiyoina ꞌihesagoheya ꞌabehega Yesu gwama Nasaleta ꞌitautau, ꞌoinega Yesu ꞌoina ꞌibwauwa, ꞌigwae, “Yesu yo, ꞌowa Debida ꞌina susu, ꞌuꞌatemuyemuyegau.”
Eeta tomota mabwaiyadi Batimiyoina siꞌausiya, sigwae, “Tuwa, ꞌulolagu!” Ma tuwa ꞌiwuiwui ꞌenana madounega, ꞌigwae, “Debida tubuna yo, ꞌuꞌatemuyemuyegau.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌitoholo henonowa, ma ꞌigwae, “Wabwauweyama.” Ma tomota sigwae, “Bwebweꞌana, ꞌutoholo. Yesu ꞌibwauwegowa.”
Coinega ꞌana ꞌabobo ꞌiꞌewayahuleya ma ꞌitoholo mwayamwayauwa, ma Yesu ꞌoina ꞌinaoma.
Cinaoma ma Yesu ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Toꞌaha nuwanuwau ma weyahiu yapaihowa?” Ma tomata gibugibuina ꞌigwaeya, “Bada, sawasawahina ma matagu ꞌugiheꞌasilala?”
Ta Yesu ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Bwebweꞌana! Cino hemisa ꞌoinega matau ꞌiꞌasilala.” Nage ꞌoina matana ꞌiꞌasilala, ma ꞌedai Yesu ꞌimuliyeya.
